races.paceDynamic: Invincible Boy looks the only confirmed early leader with his prominent style and strong 6f form, likely to set a sustainable pace without early pressure. The majority of the field comprises hold-up horses (Spaceman, Go Teejay, Eva The Deeva, Rousham) and several unknown newcomers who could press forward or sit back. With soft going potentially suiting stamina types and a lack of natural speed in the field, this sets up as a moderate gallop that will likely develop into a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position close to Invincible Boy rather than the pure hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Invincible Boy Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Invincible Boy gets an uncontested lead and the newcomers don't show early speed.
scenarios.body: He can dictate terms from the front and prove too strong in the finish, with other prominent types filling the places behind him. The hold-up horses will find it difficult to make up ground on the testing surface.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomer Shows Natural Speed
scenarios.trigger: If one of the well-bred newcomers (Star With Purpose or Davenport Lass) breaks well and shows early pace.
scenarios.body: This creates more pressure on Invincible Boy and opens up the race for a staying-on type or a horse with tactical speed. The increased gallop helps bring stamina into play on the soft ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses go forward early creating an honest gallop throughout.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo plays to the strengths of hold-up horses like Spaceman who can stay on strongly. Prominent runners may find themselves under more pressure than ideal.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Crawl Then Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If none of the newcomers show pace and Invincible Boy gets an extremely slow lead.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where raw ability matters most over tactical positioning. This could suit a well-bred newcomer with natural acceleration.

watchPoints.text: Invincible Boy could get too easy a lead if none of the newcomers show early pace, making him very hard to peg back
Star With Purpose and Davenport Lass market moves will be crucial given their unknown ability levels
Spaceman needs others to go fast early - if it's a crawl he'll be poorly positioned for his preferred late run
King's Road Dandy returns after 244 days and gelding operation so fitness and attitude need monitoring
The Easterby stable runs both Milford Grange and Davenport Lass so watch for any market signals between the pair

races.paceDynamic: Arabian Desert appears the sole genuine pace-setter in this 8-runner maiden field, with most others holding prominent or hold-up styles that suggest they'll settle behind. With no genuine speed rivals to engage him, Arabian Desert can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages without pressure. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will likely be steady rather than strong, setting up a scenario where horses can quicken from off the pace. This race shape clearly favours prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can finish strongly, rather than the lone front-runner who may be vulnerable to being reeled in.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Arabian Desert maintains a steady tempo without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace challenges allows the class horse to control his effort and kick clear when asked. His Horris Hill form gives him a significant edge over this moderate opposition.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace sets up perfectly for hold-up runners with a finishing kick
scenarios.body: The controlled tempo allows patient riders to wind up their mounts for decisive late rallies. Hold-up horses get the ideal scenario to showcase any hidden ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Arabian Desert sets things up perfectly for a horse tracking him closely
scenarios.body: A prominent runner gets the ideal tow into the race and can strike when the leader begins to tire. The pace-setter does the hard work but gets caught close home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Clough possesses significantly more ability than his stablemates suggest
scenarios.body: The gelding operations and connections' patience suggest hidden potential that could overwhelm this modest field. Market support would be the key indicator.

watchPoints.text: Arabian Desert's market position - any significant drift would suggest the lone pace angle isn't as strong as it appears
Clough's betting movements given he's the sole newcomer with wind operations and patient connections
Early positioning of Haayimm and Seattle Chief - if both sit close to Arabian Desert it changes the pace dynamic completely
How aggressively Jason Hart rides Regulus Black in the early stages given his uncertain running style
Whether the hold-up horses get cover or are forced wide, as track position will be crucial in a slowly-run race

races.paceDynamic: Uppercase is the sole confirmed front runner and will face no early pressure with Kokanee, Poet's Dawn, and Not Me content to sit just off the pace in prominent positions. This creates a moderate tempo through the early stages, allowing Uppercase to dictate terms without being harassed. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the race will likely develop into a tactical affair where those able to quicken from midfield or closer have significant advantages. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent runners with tactical speed over pure front runners, as Uppercase may find himself vulnerable to late challenges despite controlling the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows closers to get into perfect striking positions turning for home
scenarios.body: Uppercase's uncontested lead becomes a liability as fresh finishers sweep past him in the final two furlongs. The soft ground aids stamina types who can quicken late rather than those who've done the donkey work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace lifts slightly mid-race but not enough to stop tactical runners
scenarios.body: Kokanee or Poet's Dawn can position perfectly behind Uppercase and have enough left to collar him when it matters. Their race fitness and tactical positioning gives them the edge over hold-up horses who may find too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Uppercase gets easy fractions early and the field fails to organize an effective challenge
scenarios.body: The lack of serious pace pressure through the middle stages leaves Uppercase with enough in reserve to resist late challenges. His fitness edge from recent running helps him stay strong to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a true staying test and exposed favorites disappoint
scenarios.body: Character Testing's jumping background or Zowal's drop in class proves decisive as the principals underperform. The soft ground and tactical pace suits an improver or returning runner.

watchPoints.text: Uppercase could steal this if allowed completely uncontested fractions by the prominent runners
Urban Road's turf return after 20-month absence makes him unreliable despite all-weather promise
Alpha Capture's close third on stable debut suggests he's ready to strike off same mark
Character Testing's 645-day absence and jumping background creates complete form mystery
Poet's Dawn's poor reappearance record conflicts with his retained ability when race-fit

races.paceDynamic: Pink Azalea will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this field. Swift Salian may press but his prominent style won't create significant early pressure on the leader. This sets up a moderate, sustainable gallop that will allow Pink Azalea to control fractions through the first six furlongs before the field bunches entering the final three furlongs. With seven hold-up horses including Latin, Salaria, and Mount King needing to make ground late, this race shape clearly favors front-runners and prominent racers who can secure forward positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Azalea dictates comfortable fractions without early pressure from Swift Salian or others
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls every call and kicks clear in the straight while the massed ranks of hold-up horses struggle to make meaningful inroads on soft ground. This tactical advantage proves decisive as the closing brigade arrives too late despite their weight advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong through prominent horses pressing Pink Azalea early
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop sets up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to unleash telling strikes in the final furlong. Mount King and Latin benefit most from their course form and low weights respectively.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improver Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Salaria's recent AW form translates directly to turf conditions
scenarios.body: The four-time winner for this yard repeats her Pontefract success from good-to-soft ground last year while others disappoint. Her hold-up style works because the pace becomes honest enough to set up her late kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Returning Veteran Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Swift Salian produces peak form despite his 201-day absence
scenarios.body: The seasoned campaigner's class tells after a perfect preparation, using his prominent style to track Pink Azalea before pouncing. His turf form from soft ground gives him the edge over rivals struggling with conditions.

watchPoints.text: Pink Azalea bolting up if allowed to dictate easy fractions unchallenged given her soft ground preference and front-running style
Swift Salian's fitness levels after 201-day absence when early pace pressing will be crucial to race dynamics
Latin's turf form transfer from recent AW success with quick turnaround potentially masking fitness concerns
Mount King's response to tongue-tie addition on return to his favorite Pontefract venue after long break
Salaria building on excellent yard record if soft conditions suit her hold-up style perfectly

races.paceDynamic: Spartan Arrow will likely take early control with Purosangue, Seven Questions, Vantheman, Dark Cloud Rising, and Lethal Nymph all having prominent tendencies creating a contested early pace over this sprint distance. The sustained pace should hold throughout the 5f trip with multiple horses wanting to be handy. This contested pace scenario will particularly suit the hold-up merchants like Kylian, Elegant Erin, Atomic Force and Havana Rum who can deliver late kicks. The tactical verdict strongly favours HOLD-UP horses who can benefit from the strong gallop and finish off the back of it.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent brigade goes too hard early and creates a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The multiple front-runners will compromise each other's chances allowing the closers to sweep up late with Kylian, Elegant Erin and Atomic Force perfectly positioned to exploit the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the forward horses can dictate more comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: Spartan Arrow or Purosangue could control the tempo better than expected and kick clear in the final furlong before the hold-up horses can reel them in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Strike Success
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes too slow early then quickens dramatically
scenarios.body: The lack of a single strong pace-setter could create tactical racing until a furious finish where horses like Arklow Lad and Reigning Profit can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Spartan Arrow gets an uncontested lead and controls the race
scenarios.body: With his class advantage he could dictate ideal fractions and prove too tough in the closing stages despite the hold-up horses' finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Spartan Arrow getting an uncontested lead as his class could prove decisive if allowed easy fractions
Monitor the early pace with so many prominent runners - if they go too fast it will set up perfectly for the closers
Keep an eye on Kylian's finishing kick as the cheekpieces and hold-up style could be the perfect combination here
Watch Elegant Erin's positioning as the 9-year-old needs the race to develop into a sprint finish to be effective
Observe whether Arklow Lad can transfer his AW form to turf as the low-mileage 4-year-old remains unexposed

races.paceDynamic: Secret Alliance will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, with Princess Niyla and Very Muddy Waters likely to settle prominently behind. The pace should be sustainable rather than contested, as most runners prefer to come from midfield or further back. This tactical setup creates an advantage for hold-up horses like Fleur De Mer, Cloudy Rose, and Starshine Legend who can finish strongly. The race shape clearly favours hold-up performers who can benefit from the steady gallop and finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Alliance gets an easy lead without pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for closers to make up ground and the leader gets first run on his rivals. Secret Alliance or another front-runner capitalizes on the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but not overly strong, setting up perfectly for closers
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop allows hold-up horses to conserve energy before unleashing late charges down the home straight. Quality closers with the best finishing kicks prevail over the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Princess Niyla or Very Muddy Waters can track the leader and kick clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the best of both worlds - a good position without doing the donkey work. They can respond to the leader's move while having enough left to hold off late challengers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Alliance goes too slowly early and the field bunches up approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from the back of the pack where any horse can win. Form and class become less relevant as positioning in the final 200 yards determines the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Secret Alliance could get an uncontested lead if Princess Niyla and Very Muddy Waters don't take him on early
Fleur De Mer sports first-time cheekpieces which could provide the improvement needed from her current mark
Starshine Legend returns after 580 days but trainer Olly Murphy has excellent record with horses returning from long breaks
Very Muddy Waters wears first-time blinkers but has been off for 157 days which raises fitness concerns
Cloudy Rose won off today's exact mark last season but needs to prove her fitness after six-month absence

races.paceDynamic: Antique Blue will take this race to the front from the off and set a steady pace without serious pressure from any confirmed front-runner. Mystical Land, The Tunguska Event, Maynora and Full Gas will track him prominently, but the lack of early pace pressure means the tempo will be manageable through the middle sections. This sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to unleash late runs in the final two furlongs on ground that will reward stamina. The race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up horses who can capitalise on the sustainable pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Antique Blue maintains his lead without serious challenge and the pace stays modest throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets an easy time of it and the prominent racers can't generate enough late kick to reel him in. Horses tracking in second and third benefit from the perfect stalking position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late
scenarios.trigger: If the steady early pace allows the hold-up horses to unleash telling late runs in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lack of early burn-up means stamina becomes crucial and the back-markers can use the soft ground to their advantage. Multiple hold-up horses converge with strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can quicken decisively from the perfect stalking position turning for home
scenarios.body: The horse gets the ideal trip behind the uncontested leader and has enough left to strike when it matters. The tactical position proves superior to both front-running and closing tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Maiden Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and becomes a sprint finish favouring an unconsidered runner
scenarios.body: The slow tempo neutralises class differences and allows a lightly-raced improver to showcase untapped ability. The soft ground plays to different strengths than previous runs.

races.paceDynamic: Iris Dancer will attempt to lead from stall 1, but faces immediate pressure from six prominent runners (Ganesha, Monotone, Get Up Everybody, Jojo Rabbit, Lucius Aurelius, Pinjarra) all wanting forward positions in a 14-runner field. This creates a bunched, competitive pace with multiple horses vying for tactical spots in the opening two furlongs. The inevitable scrimmaging and traffic problems 2-3 out will disadvantage those needing clear runs, while the sustained pace will stretch the field and favour horses that can position handily without getting embroiled in the early skirmishes. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners with tactical speed who can avoid the worst of the early congestion.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Congestion Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners all go forward aggressively from the start creating pace pressure
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainably fast as multiple horses dispute positions, setting up the race for hold-up horses who avoid the carnage and can produce late runs when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Positioning Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Iris Dancer leads but prominent runners settle just behind creating a true-run race
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuine but not destructive, with the winner coming from those who secure good positions without over-racing, favouring the more experienced prominent runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Iris Dancer Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Iris Dancer gets an easy lead with the prominent pack settling further back than expected
scenarios.body: The veteran mare controls the fractions and makes it a test of who can quicken best from off the pace, suiting those with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wide Draw Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If the wide-drawn horses use their outside berths to avoid the internal scrimmaging completely
scenarios.body: Clean runs from the outside prove decisive as the inner pack gets tangled up, allowing horses like Pinjarra to sweep around the field.

watchPoints.text: If Iris Dancer gets pressured early by multiple prominent runners, the pace will collapse and favor hold-up horses like Harb and Kitaab
Watch for Monotone and Get Up Everybody both trying to go forward from adjacent draws creating a bottleneck
Pinjarra from stall 14 needs to use his wide draw effectively or he'll get caught behind the prominent pack
Jojo Rabbit's recent Wolverhampton run suggests he's ready to fire after his seasonal reappearance
Wrestling Revenue's 66-day break looks ideal for a horse who won this course in similar conditions
